title: Unify ApiError and GlobalExceptionHandler across services
body:
The 7 services each returned errors in a different format, so the frontend had to parse each one separately. This PR adds a unified error body `ApiError {code, message, details}` and a `GlobalExceptionHandler` in every service that maps 404, 409 and 400 in one place. The domain layer only throws `BusinessRuleException`, `NotFoundException` and `ValidationException` and no longer references Spring Web types.

## Validation

- Controller tests in all 7 services now assert `$.code`; all pass.
- The frontend error message component parses only one structure; manual regression of login, account inquiry and card maintenance.
author: Su Qing
